name: Wand Expert grants ranged attack power and hit rating from Spirit (#2180)
contract: Wand Expert 574308 carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT (212, EffectMiscValue Stats::STAT_SPIRIT 4, EffectBasePoints 99 -> 100%) and SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220, EffectMiscValue 224 = CR_HIT_MELEE|CR_HIT_RANGED|CR_HIT_SPELL bits, EffectMiscValueB Stats::STAT_SPIRIT 4, EffectBasePoints 4 -> 5%). Both handlers (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModRangedAttackPowerOfStatPercent, AuraEffect::HandleModRatingFromStat) are native and recalculate on apply.
